strings: m_c had been copying r_c's every move since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} joined the Clan.
r_c made an effort to understand what drew m_c to join c_n.
m_c recognized r_c as a cat who had never demeaned kittypets during encounters near the border.
m_c was thrilled when r_c bounded up to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to ask {PRONOUN/m_c/object} about {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life.
